headline: Anthropic Targets $1.4 Trillion Valuation in Stock Debut Filing
summary: AI startup Anthropic has filed for an initial public offering, targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion. The prospectus outlines existential risks alongside financial details for the maker of the Claude chatbot.
why: Anthropic is a top artificial intelligence research firm developing large language models that compete directly with OpenAI and Google.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Anthropic's IPO filing at a record valuation targets public equity capital for its AI infrastructure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The prospect of a record-breaking $1.4 trillion IPO valuation draws significant market attention to the public equity valuation of AI infrastructure firms.
